fusions.name: Bolt at the Report
fusions.desc: Flicks the tip at the first enemy it meets, which deals 7 damage, and you move 25% faster for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Running Report
fusions.desc: Cracks the lash off the run, which deals 3 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%).

fusions.name: Startled Spring
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 6 seconds and springs you 2 tiles from where you stood. You also have 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Pricked Ears
fusions.desc: You have 25% more critical chance against enemies that have not been hurt yet. When you land a critical hit, 8 stamina comes back to you. Once every 6 seconds.
